chunks: My father narrated, may God be pleased with him, saying: Abul-Hassan Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali ibn Asad Al-Asady narrated to me, saying: Muhammad ibn Abi Ayoob al-Nahravi narrated to me, saying: Ja'far ibn Sanid ibn Davood narrated to me, saying: My father narrated to me, saying: Yusuf ibn Muhammad ibn Munkadir narrated to us, from his father, from Jabir ibn Abdullah, saying: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The mother of Solomon (peace be upon him) said to Solomon (peace be upon him): Beware of much sleeping at night, for much sleeping at night leaves the man poor on the Day of Resurrection.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of excessive night sleep according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights this advice from the mother of Prophet Solomon (peace be upon him) to warn against the spiritual lethargy caused by excessive night sleep, which leads to poverty in the Hereafter. This narration underscores the Shia emphasis on night worship (*Qiyam al-Layl*) as a means to accumulate divine wealth and avoid the 'poverty' of neglecting one's duties to God.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 1-99 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Abul-Hassan Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Asad Al-Asady quoted on the authority of Muhammad ibn Abi Ayoob al-Nahravi, on the authority of Ja’far ibn Sanid ibn Davood, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Yusuf ibn Muhammad ibn Munkadir, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Jabir ibn Abdullah that God’s Prophet (MGB) said that
the mother of Solomon the son of David, told Solomon, “Beware that sleeping too much at night will make one poor in the Hereafter.”
